title: Self Portrait
description: A portrait composed with basic geometric shapes.

title: Generative Portrait
description: Randomized marks and overlapping shapes build an evolving portrait.

title: Portrait in Motion
description: A fading portrait made from shifting lines, rectangles, and color.

title: Particle Network
description: Moving particles connect when nearby. Click to introduce more particles.

title: Particle Brush
description: Move across the grid to disturb the lines. Click to push nearby particles outward.

title: DADA Collage
description: Drag to compose with image and text fragments. Click to scatter; Space clears; S saves.

title: Fog Glass
description: Wipe misted glass with your hands. A clap switches tools as droplets slowly leave their own trails.
